title: Figure 1. Relationship between Workload and Task Performance (one-dimensional model)
description: Line chart titled "Relationship between Workload and Task Performance" plotting a magenta "Performance" curve and a blue "Workload" curve from Low to High against "Task Demand" increasing to the right, divided into regions D, A1, A2, A3, B, and C. Captioned "Figure 1. One-dimensional Representation of Changes in Performance as Workload Varies," with an explanation that A2 is optimal and region C is overload where performance degrades.
